topic: Safety and emergency devices for retraction and extension, typical u/c circuits
syllabus_extract: Safety and emergency devices for retraction and extension, typical u/c circuits,
specific_objectives: 17.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to describe typical alighting gears of an aircraft and its construction.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of typical u/c circuit diagrams; Instructor supervision required for safety device identification
intro_questions: What are the primary functions of the landing gear system?
Name two safety devices used to prevent accidental gear retraction.
How does the emergency extension system differ from normal retraction?

topics: Safety devices for retraction and extension
development.content:
Typical alighting gear construction
Safety devices for retraction and extension
Emergency extension mechanisms
Typical u/c circuit components
Hydraulic and mechanical interlocks

Analysis of u/c circuit diagrams
Identification of safety valves
Operation of emergency extension
Role of uplocks and downlocks
System pressure monitoring

Review of safety protocols
Troubleshooting common failures
Summary of circuit logic
Preparation for shock absorber study
Q&A session

summary_questions: Explain the function of the uplock mechanism in the landing gear circuit.
Describe the sequence of events during an emergency gear extension.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between normal and emergency landing gear extension procedures to be discussed in LP 12.
